CREATE VIEW _birthday_list AS
SELECT C.id AS contact_id, C.name, C.first_name, score, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1
  FROM birthday_views AS BV
  WHERE BV.contact_id = C.id AND BV.last_seen_timestamp_ms >= (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 - 86400000) AS is_unread
  FROM ranking_scores AS RS
  LEFT JOIN contacts AS C ON C.id = RS.contact_id
  WHERE RS.contact_type = 20 AND RS.score_type = 0 AND C.contact_viewer_relationship = 2 AND C.id <> ( SELECT facebook_user_id
  FROM _user_info )

CREATE VIEW _combined_story_buckets AS
SELECT S.owner_id, C.name AS name, 'Your Story' AS first_name, C.profile_picture_url, C.profile_picture_fallback_url, C.profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, S.story_expiration_timestamp_ms, story_id, media_id, media_preview_url, media_preview_fallback_url, media_preview_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, media_preview_width, media_preview_height, media_thumbnail_url, media_thumbnail_fallback_url, media_thumbnail_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, media_thumbnail_width, media_thumbnail_height, SB.is_being_posted, SB.is_being_deleted, is_expired, 0 AS has_unread, CASE WHEN SB.is_being_posted THEN 3
ELSE 1
END AS story_ring_state, 0 AS should_show_online_indicator, 0.0 AS score, '-1' AS request_id, 0 AS score_index, 0 AS last_active_timestamp_ms
  FROM _user_info AS UI
  INNER JOIN most_recent_stories AS S ON UI.facebook_user_id = S.owner_id
  INNER JOIN contacts AS C ON UI.facebook_user_id = C.id
  INNER JOIN _story_bucket_states AS SB ON UI.facebook_user_id = SB.owner_id
UNION ALL
SELECT owner_id, name, IFNULL(first_name, name) AS first_name, profile_picture_url, profile_picture_fallback_url, profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, story_expiration_timestamp_ms, story_id, media_id, media_preview_url, media_preview_fallback_url, media_preview_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, media_preview_width, media_preview_height, media_thumbnail_url, media_thumbnail_fallback_url, media_thumbnail_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, media_thumbnail_width, media_thumbnail_height, 0 AS is_being_posted, 0 AS is_being_deleted, is_expired, has_unread, story_ring_state, should_show_online_indicator, IFNULL(score, 0.0) AS score, IFNULL(request_id, '-1') AS request_id, IFNULL(score_index, 0) AS score_index, IFNULL(last_active_timestamp_ms, 0) AS last_active_timestamp_ms
  FROM _friend_story_buckets

CREATE VIEW _friend_story_buckets AS
SELECT owner_id, S.first_name, S.name, S.profile_picture_url, S.profile_picture_fallback_url, S.profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, S.story_expiration_timestamp_ms, story_id, media_id, media_preview_url, media_preview_fallback_url, media_preview_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, media_preview_width, media_preview_height, media_thumbnail_url, media_thumbnail_fallback_url, media_thumbnail_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, media_thumbnail_width, media_thumbnail_height, is_expired, NOT is_read AS has_unread, CASE WHEN is_read = 1 THEN 1
ELSE 2
END AS story_ring_state, status IS 2 AS should_show_online_indicator, RS.score, RR.request_id, RS.score_index, P.last_active_timestamp_ms
  FROM _user_info AS UI
  INNER JOIN most_recent_stories_with_name AS S ON UI.facebook_user_id <> S.owner_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN presence_states AS P ON S.owner_id = P.contact_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ranking_scores AS RS ON S.owner_id = RS.contact_id AND RS.score_type = 2
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ranking_requests AS RR ON RR.score_type = 2
ORDER BY is_read ASC, RS.score DESC

CREATE VIEW _participant_thread_info AS
WITH
_sync_groups (sync_group) AS (SELECT DISTINCT T.sync_group AS sync_group
  FROM threads AS T
UNION
SELECT 0 AS sync_group),
actor_info (actor_id, sync_group) AS (SELECT actor_id_for_sync_group(SG.sync_group, UI.facebook_user_id) AS actor_id, SG.sync_group AS sync_group
  FROM _user_info AS UI
  INNER JOIN _sync_groups AS SG)
SELECT T.thread_key, CASE WHEN count(P.contact_id) > 1 THEN group_concat(CASE WHEN P.nickname IS NOT NULL AND P.nickname <> '' THEN P.nickname
WHEN C.first_name IS NOT NULL AND C.first_name <> '' THEN C.first_name
WHEN C.name IS NOT NULL AND C.name <> '' THEN C.name
WHEN T.thread_subtype IN (1006, 48) THEN 'Workplace User'
ELSE 'Facebook User'
END, ', ')
WHEN count(P.contact_id) = 1 THEN group_concat(coalesce(P.nickname, CASE WHEN C.name = '' THEN NULL
ELSE C.name
END, CASE WHEN T.thread_subtype IN (1006, 48) THEN 'Workplace User'
ELSE 'Facebook User'
END), ', ')
WHEN T.mailbox_type = 4096 THEN NULL
WHEN T.thread_name IS NULL AND T.authority_level = 40 THEN ''
ELSE ( SELECT name
  FROM contacts
  WHERE id = AI.actor_id )
END AS thread_name, CASE WHEN count(P.contact_id) > 1 THEN group_concat(CASE WHEN P.nickname IS NOT NULL AND P.nickname <> '' THEN P.nickname
WHEN C.first_name IS NOT NULL AND C.first_name <> '' THEN C.first_name
WHEN C.name IS NOT NULL AND C.name <> '' THEN C.name
WHEN T.thread_subtype IN (1006, 48) THEN 'Workplace User'
ELSE 'Facebook User'
END, ', ')
WHEN count(P.contact_id) = 1 THEN group_concat(coalesce(CASE WHEN C.name = '' THEN NULL
ELSE C.name
END, CASE WHEN T.thread_subtype IN (1006, 48) THEN 'Workplace User'
ELSE 'Facebook User'
END), ', ')
WHEN T.mailbox_type = 4096 THEN NULL
WHEN T.thread_name IS NULL AND T.authority_level = 40 THEN ''
ELSE ( SELECT name
  FROM contacts
  WHERE id = AI.actor_id )
END AS thread_name_without_nickname, CASE WHEN T.thread_type = 2 THEN NULL
WHEN T.thread_key = AI.actor_id THEN ( SELECT profile_picture_url
  FROM contacts
  WHERE id = AI.actor_id )
ELSE C.profile_picture_url
END AS other_participant_profile_picture_url, CASE WHEN T.thread_type = 2 THEN NULL
WHEN T.thread_key = AI.actor_id THEN ( SELECT profile_picture_fallback_url
  FROM contacts
  WHERE id = AI.actor_id )
ELSE C.profile_picture_fallback_url
END AS other_participant_profile_picture_fallback_url, CASE WHEN T.thread_type = 2 THEN NULL
WHEN T.thread_key = AI.actor_id THEN ( SELECT profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms
  FROM contacts
  WHERE id = AI.actor_id )
ELSE C.profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms
END AS other_participant_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, MAX(C.restriction_type) AS restriction_type, CASE WHEN T.thread_type = 2 AND thread_info_profile_image_list_enabled() THEN ( SELECT group_concat(profile_picture_url, ',')
  FROM (SELECT PP.thread_key AS thread_key, CC.profile_picture_url
  FROM participants AS PP
  LEFT OUTER JOIN contacts AS CC ON CC.id = PP.contact_id
  WHERE PP.thread_key = T.thread_key AND PP.contact_id <> AI.actor_id AND CC.profile_picture_url <> ''
ORDER BY CC.rank DESC
LIMIT 2) )
END AS other_participant_profile_picture_url_list, CASE WHEN T.thread_type = 2 AND thread_info_profile_image_list_enabled() THEN ( SELECT group_concat(profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, ',')
  FROM (SELECT PP.thread_key AS thread_key, CC.profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms
  FROM participants AS PP
  LEFT OUTER JOIN contacts AS CC ON CC.id = PP.contact_id
  WHERE PP.thread_key = T.thread_key AND PP.contact_id <> AI.actor_id
ORDER BY CC.rank DESC
LIMIT 2) )
END AS other_participant_url_expiration_timestamp_ms_list, CASE WHEN T.thread_type = 2 AND thread_info_profile_image_list_enabled() THEN ( SELECT group_concat(profile_picture_fallback_url, ',')
  FROM (SELECT PP.thread_key AS thread_key, CC.profile_picture_fallback_url
  FROM participants AS PP
  LEFT OUTER JOIN contacts AS CC ON CC.id = PP.contact_id
  WHERE PP.thread_key = T.thread_key AND PP.contact_id <> AI.actor_id AND CC.profile_picture_fallback_url <> ''
ORDER BY CC.rank DESC
LIMIT 2) )
END AS other_participant_profile_picture_fallback_url_list, CASE WHEN count(P.contact_id) > 1 THEN group_concat(CASE WHEN C.contact_type_exact = 16 THEN NULL
WHEN P.nickname IS NOT NULL AND P.nickname <> '' THEN P.nickname
WHEN C.first_name IS NOT NULL AND C.first_name <> '' THEN C.first_name
WHEN C.name IS NOT NULL AND C.name <> '' THEN C.name
WHEN T.thread_subtype IN (1006, 48) THEN 'Workplace User'
ELSE 'Facebook User'
END, ', ')
WHEN count(P.contact_id) = 1 THEN group_concat(CASE WHEN C.contact_type_exact = 16 THEN NULL
ELSE coalesce(CASE WHEN C.name = '' THEN NULL
ELSE C.name
END, CASE WHEN T.thread_subtype IN (1006, 48) THEN 'Workplace User'
ELSE 'Facebook User'
END)
END, ', ')
WHEN T.mailbox_type = 4096 THEN NULL
WHEN T.thread_name IS NULL AND T.authority_level = 40 THEN ''
ELSE ( SELECT name
  FROM contacts
  WHERE id = AI.actor_id )
END AS thread_name_without_bot_name
  FROM _user_info AS UI
  INNER JOIN threads AS T
  INNER JOIN actor_info AS AI ON AI.sync_group = ifnull(T.sync_group, 0)
  LEFT OUTER JOIN participants AS P ON P.thread_key = T.thread_key AND P.contact_id <> AI.actor_id AND P.group_participant_join_state <> 2
  LEFT OUTER JOIN contacts AS C ON C.id = P.contact_id
  WHERE UI.id = 1
  GROUP BY T.thread_key

  FROM messages

CREATE VIEW _thread_last_message_read_participants AS
SELECT M.thread_key AS thread_key, group_concat(C.profile_picture_url) AS profile_picture_urls, group_concat(C.profile_picture_fallback_url) AS profile_picture_fallback_urls, group_concat(C.profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms) AS profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamps_ms
  FROM _user_info AS UI
  INNER JOIN _thread_last_message AS M ON M.sender_id = UI.facebook_user_id
  LEFT JOIN participants AS P ON P.thread_key = M.thread_key AND P.contact_id <> M.sender_id AND P.read_watermark_timestamp_ms >= M.timestamp_ms
  LEFT JOIN contacts AS C ON P.contact_id = C.id
  WHERE UI.id = 1
  GROUP BY M.thread_key

CREATE VIEW _thread_last_message_read_status AS
SELECT M.thread_key, CASE MAX(M.send_status_v2) WHEN 0 THEN 0
WHEN 1 THEN 1
WHEN 2 THEN CASE WHEN MAX(P.read_watermark_timestamp_ms) >= MAX(M.timestamp_ms) THEN 4
WHEN MAX(P.delivered_watermark_timestamp_ms) >= MAX(M.timestamp_ms) THEN 3
ELSE 2
END
WHEN 4 THEN 6
WHEN 5 THEN 5
WHEN 6 THEN 2
ELSE 0
END AS read_status
  FROM _user_info AS UI
  INNER JOIN _thread_last_message AS M ON M.sender_id = UI.facebook_user_id
  LEFT JOIN participants AS P ON P.thread_key = M.thread_key AND P.contact_id <> M.sender_id
  WHERE UI.id = 1
  GROUP BY M.thread_key

CREATE VIEW _thread_read_status AS
SELECT RS.thread_key AS thread_key, RS.read_status AS read_status, RP.profile_picture_urls, RP.profile_picture_fallback_urls, RP.profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamps_ms
  FROM _thread_last_message_read_status AS RS
  LEFT JOIN _thread_last_message_read_participants AS RP ON RP.thread_key = RS.thread_key

CREATE VIEW _top_active_now_contacts AS

  LEFT OUTER JOIN ranking_scores AS RS ON RS.contact_id = P.contact_id AND RS.score_type = 0
  LEFT OUTER JOIN ranking_requests AS RR ON RR.score_type = 0
  WHERE status = 2
ORDER BY RS.score DESC

ELSE 0
END) )

ELSE NULL

ELSE P.read_watermark_timestamp_ms

ELSE 0
END) AS num_active_members
  FROM _user_info AS UI
  INNER JOIN participants AS P
  LEFT OUTER JOIN presence_states AS PS ON PS.contact_id = P.contact_id AND PS.contact_id <> UI.facebook_user_id
  GROUP BY P.thread_key

CREATE VIEW thread_theme_colors AS

  FROM gradient_colors AS GC
  WHERE GC.theme_fbid = TT.fbid AND GC.type = 0
ORDER BY GC.gradient_index ) AS gradient_colors, preview_url, preview_url_fallback, preview_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, thread_key, animated_background_url, animated_background_url_fallback, animated_background_url_expiration_timestamp_ms
  FROM thread_themes AS TT
ORDER BY TT.theme_idx

ELSE NULL
END) AS delivery_receipt_gradient_colors, TT.description, TT.icon_url, TT.icon_url_fallback, TT.icon_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, group_concat(CASE WHEN GC.type = 2 THEN GC.color

ELSE NULL
END) AS composer_circle_gradient_colors, group_concat(CASE WHEN GC.type = 5 THEN GC.color
ELSE NULL
END) AS composer_send_gradient_colors, group_concat(CASE WHEN GC.type = 6 THEN GC.color
ELSE NULL
END) AS emphasis_gradient_colors, TT.preview_url, TT.preview_url_fallback, TT.preview_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, TT.thread_key, TT.animated_background_url, TT.animated_background_url_fallback, TT.animated_background_url_expiration_timestamp_ms
  FROM thread_themes AS TT
  LEFT JOIN gradient_colors AS GC ON GC.theme_fbid = TT.fbid
  GROUP BY TT.fbid
ORDER BY GC.gradient_index

CREATE VIEW threads_additional_info_needed_to_search AS
SELECT CAST(T.thread_key AS TEXT) AS entity_id, T.thread_key, COALESCE(T.thread_name, CPTI.thread_name) AS thread_name, T.thread_picture_url AS profile_image_url, T.thread_picture_url_fallback AS profile_image_fallback_url, T.thread_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms AS profile_image_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, T.capabilities AS threads_capabilities, T.capabilities_2 AS threads_capabilities_2, T.thread_type, C.first_name AS contact_first_name, C.normalized_search_terms AS contact_normalized_search_terms, C.secondary_name AS contact_secondary_name, C.last_name AS contact_last_name, C.phonetic_first_name AS contact_phonetic_first_name, C.phonetic_last_name AS contact_phonetic_last_name, C.phonetic_full_name AS contact_phonetic_full_name, C.username AS contact_username, C.name AS contact_name, C.capabilities AS contact_capabilities, C.capabilities_2 AS contact_capabilities_2, C.contact_type_exact, C.contact_viewer_relationship, C.rank AS contact_rank_score, CPTI.thread_name AS cpti_thread_name
  FROM threads AS T
  LEFT OUTER JOIN participants AS P ON T.thread_key = P.thread_key
  LEFT OUTER JOIN contacts AS C ON C.id = P.contact_id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN _cached_participant_thread_info AS CPTI ON CPTI.thread_key = T.thread_key
  WHERE CASE WHEN T.thread_type = 2 THEN 1
WHEN T.thread_type = 1 THEN C.blocked_by_viewer_status = 0 AND C.capabilities_2 IS NOT NULL AND 4 & C.capabilities_2 = 0 AND 1024 & C.capabilities_2 = 0 AND 16384 & C.capabilities_2 = 0
ELSE 1
END

CREATE VIEW threads_ranges_info__generated AS
SELECT folder_name, _min_last_activity_timestamp_ms IS NOT NULL AND _min_thread_key IS NOT NULL AS has_before, _max_last_activity_timestamp_ms IS NOT NULL AND _max_thread_key IS NOT NULL AS has_after, _is_loading_before AS is_loading_before, _is_loading_after AS is_loading_after
  FROM threads_ranges__generated

CREATE VIEW threads_ranges_info_v2__generated AS
SELECT parent_thread_key, _has_more_before AS has_before, _has_more_after AS has_after, _is_loading_before AS is_loading_before, _is_loading_after AS is_loading_after, _min_thread_key AS min_thread_key, _min_last_activity_timestamp_ms AS min_last_activity_timestamp_ms, _max_thread_key AS max_thread_key, _max_last_activity_timestamp_ms AS max_last_activity_timestamp_ms
  FROM threads_ranges_v2__generated

CREATE VIEW tray_stories_list_items AS
SELECT B.owner_id, 2 AS item_type, C.first_name, C.name, C.contact_type_exact, 0 AS badge_type, 0 AS badge_count, -1 AS folder_id, -1 AS fb_group_id, story_id, S.timestamp_ms AS story_creation_timestamp_ms, S.timestamp_ms + S.ttl_ms AS story_expiration_timestamp_ms, media_id, C.profile_picture_url AS media_url, C.profile_picture_url_expiration_timestamp_ms AS media_url_expiration_timestamp_ms, C.profile_picture_fallback_url AS media_fallback_url, C.profile_ring_state = 1 OR C.profile_ring_state = 5 AS has_unread, MAX(posting_status) AS posting_status, S.media_thumbnail_url, S.media_preview_url, CASE WHEN posting_status = 3 THEN 4
WHEN MIN(S.authority_level) = 20 THEN CASE WHEN C.profile_ring_state = 6 THEN 6
ELSE 3
END
ELSE ifnull(C.profile_ring_state, 0)
END AS story_ring_state, CASE WHEN posting_status = 3 THEN 4
WHEN MIN(S.authority_level) = 20 THEN CASE WHEN C.profile_ring_state = 6 THEN 6
ELSE 3
END
WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1
  FROM _birthday_list
  WHERE _birthday_list.contact_id = B.owner_id AND _birthday_list.is_unread = 1) THEN 1
ELSE ifnull(C.profile_ring_state, 0)
END AS story_ring_state_with_birthday, 0 AS should_show_online_indicator, P.last_active_timestamp_ms, UI.facebook_user_id = B.owner_id AS is_self_story, B.bucket_id, B.bucket_score, EXISTS (SELECT 1
  FROM _birthday_list
  WHERE _birthday_list.contact_id = B.owner_id) AS has_birthday, EXISTS (SELECT 1
  FROM _birthday_list
  WHERE _birthday_list.contact_id = B.owner_id AND _birthday_list.is_unread = 1) AS has_unread_birthday
  FROM _user_info AS UI
  INNER JOIN stories AS S
  INNER JOIN story_buckets AS B ON B.bucket_id = S.bucket_id AND B.bucket_type = 1
  INNER JOIN contacts AS C ON B.owner_id = C.id
  LEFT OUTER JOIN presence_states AS P ON B.owner_id = P.contact_id
  GROUP BY owner_id
  HAVING (julianday('now') - 2440587.5) * 86400000 - S.timestamp_ms <= S.ttl_ms AND (C.capabilities_2 IS NULL OR C.capabilities_2 & 1024 = 0) AND (C.capabilities_2 IS NULL OR C.capabilities_2 & 4 = 0) AND B.should_show_in_tray = 1 AND C.blocked_by_viewer_status = 0

CREATE VIEW unread_not_muted_threads_count AS
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM (SELECT mute_expire_time_ms, last_activity_timestamp_ms, last_read_watermark_timestamp_ms
  FROM threads
  WHERE folder_name = 'inbox' AND is_hidden = 0
ORDER BY last_activity_timestamp_ms DESC
LIMIT 20)
  WHERE mute_expire_time_ms >= 0 AND last_activity_timestamp_ms > last_read_watermark_timestamp_ms AND mute_expire_time_ms - CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS REAL) * 1000 <= 0

CREATE VIEW unread_pending_threads AS
SELECT COUNT(*) AS unread_pending_thread_count
  FROM threads
  WHERE last_activity_timestamp_ms > last_read_watermark_timestamp_ms AND folder_name = 'pending'
LIMIT 20

CREATE VIEW upload_contact_event_view AS
SELECT event
  FROM upload_contact_event

CREATE VIEW user_contact_info AS
SELECT C.id AS contact_id, C.name, C.phone_number, C.contact_viewer_relationship, C.email_address
  FROM contacts AS C
  WHERE C.name <> ''
ORDER BY C.name

CREATE VIEW workplace_status_recurring_enabled AS
SELECT r.user_id, CASE WHEN r.start_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT) < 0 THEN r.start_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT) + 604800
WHEN r.start_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT) > 604800 THEN r.start_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT) - 604800
ELSE r.start_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT)
END AS start_time_seconds, CASE WHEN r.end_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT) < 0 THEN r.end_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT) + 604800
WHEN r.end_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT) > 604800 THEN r.end_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT) - 604800
ELSE r.end_time_seconds - CAST(60 * gmt_offset_minutes AS LONG_INT)
END AS end_time_seconds
  FROM workplace_status_recurring AS r
  LEFT JOIN workplace_status_settings AS s ON r.user_id = s.user_id
  WHERE r.enabled = 1
